description: Use this when the person wants ideas or a starting point for a site or app, for example "show me bakery websites". Free. Returns sites and apps people built with Pugi; if none matches it returns the nearest category and says so (match: nearest_category), so tell the person they are the nearest. Each has a brief and the tool to start a similar project in this chat (build_with). It does not copy anyone's code.

limit.description: How many cards to return. Default 10.

query.description: Optional words for what the person wants, in any language, for example "booking" or "coffee shop".

tags.description: Optional tags; a card must carry every one, for example ["saas"].

name: catalog_search
title: Search the Pugi catalogue
